claims: The Coachella 2026 livestream is available for free on the official Coachella YouTube channel.
The Coachella 2026 livestream is available for free via the Coachella Livestream app.
The Coachella 2026 livestream starts at 4 p.m. PT (7 p.m. ET) each day.
The Coachella 2026 livestream covers seven stages.
The Coachella 2026 livestream includes 4K feeds for main stages.
The Coachella 2026 livestream has a "multiview" feature to watch four sets at once.
